title: Implementer guide: media stack selection
description: Section covering the media-agnostic design. What the spec leaves open (WebRTC, SIP/RTP, proprietary SFU, MCU, mesh). What you must decide. Considerations for each (latency, scalability, browser support, SRTP). Common patterns (Jitsi JVB as SFU, Opal/Ozone SIP, Opal MCU). How joinUri maps to each stack. Recommended starting point.
